verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents a first-party Windows VM feature (Install > Windows) with hardware virtualization for near-native performance, shared clipboard, file folder, and support for bringing a Windows 11 Pro license, explicitly enabling apps not natively available on Linux. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the Windows VM feature specifically (community evidence covers other aspects of Omarchy but not this VM feature), and detail on performance/compatibility limits for demanding native Windows apps.
